document.title: Requirements
document.summary: Pinned pip requirements for a small FastAPI web API using PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy, Alembic and psycopg, with JWT auth through python-jose and passlib. It separates core runtime packages from development tooling (pytest, ruff, mypy) and pins httpx as the HTTP client.
